geminiIngress.what: The Sun leaves Taurus — the fixed earth sign of the body, the voice, the garden — and enters Gemini, the mutable air sign of the mind, communication, and duality.
geminiIngress.significance: Gemini Season is the season of language. What you say. What you name. What you choose to articulate. Mercury rules this season. And Mercury is currently in Taurus — carrying the body's wisdom into the domain of speech. The word has roots.
geminiIngress.watch: Uranus is newly in Gemini. This is the first Gemini Season with Uranus in Gemini since 1942. Every time you open your mouth this season, something is being disrupted. Let it be disrupted toward truth.

activeDecans.picatrix: A Man plowing, sowing, and building — surveying what has been done
activeDecans.note: The work was done. Now you look at what actually grew. This is not disappointment — this is agricultural wisdom.

activeDecans.tarotTitle: Ruin → End of a Mental Cycle
activeDecans.picatrix: A Man with a helmet on his head, clothed in a coat of mail
activeDecans.note: The mind at the end of itself. Not the end of everything. Just the end of this particular story you were telling. Let it end.

activeDecans.picatrix: A Man with a sickle in his hand, standing in a field that has already been reaped
activeDecans.note: Mercury surveying what the body has built. Before the tongue moves, the hands know.

activeDecans.picatrix: A White Man with Red Hair clothed in red, with a golden bracelet, riding a white horse
activeDecans.note: The warrior approaching the gate of his own house. The campaign is ending. You are arriving at something.

activeDecans.tarotTitle: Established Strength · Vision at the Horizon
activeDecans.picatrix: A Woman dressed in green, lacking one hand, moving rapidly
activeDecans.note: The conjunction of order and dissolution continues. Something that seemed solid is showing its dream-nature. Stay with both.

activeDecans.picatrix: A Man holding a helmet, clothed in a coat of mail, with a sword at his side
activeDecans.note: The revolution in language and information is one degree old. We are still being blindfolded. The swords around us are our own assumptions.

herbs.name: Lavender
herbs.why: Mercury in Taurus moving into Gemini — the nervous system preparing for the season of multitasking. Lavender holds the nervous system steady through the transition.
herbs.use: Tea (1 tsp dried flowers, steep 7 minutes). Pillow sachet. Essential oil in carrier oil on temples.
herbs.caution: Minimal. Avoid concentrated essential oil internally. Some hormonal sensitivity in children.
herbs.source: Dioscorides De Materia Medica; Culpeper Complete Herbal (1653); Rosemary Gladstar

herbs.name: Elderflower
herbs.action: Diaphoretic, anti-inflammatory, sinus clearing, gentle fever support
herbs.why: Blooming now. Gemini rules the lungs, shoulders, and upper respiratory system. Elder presides over the threshold between seasons. The plant itself is a threshold plant.
herbs.use: Tea (2 tsp dried flowers, 10 min steep). Elderflower cordial. Fresh flowers in water overnight.
herbs.caution: Use flowers only — raw berries and bark contain cyanogenic compounds. Harvest with respect.
herbs.source: Matthew Wood, The Book of Herbal Wisdom; Maud Grieve, A Modern Herbal (1931)

herbs.name: Mullein
herbs.why: Gemini Season asks you to speak what you've been holding. Mullein opens the channel. The lungs where we carry what we could not say.
herbs.use: Tea (1 tsp dried leaf, 15 min steep, strain through cloth). Smoke as ceremonial lung opener.
herbs.caution: Strain very carefully — fine hairs can irritate throat.
herbs.source: Matthew Wood; Cherokee and Appalachian traditional medicine

herbs.name: Peppermint
herbs.why: The signature herb of Mercury and Gemini. Quick, sharp, dual-natured. Gemini Season calls for mental agility. This is the herb of the quick mind.
herbs.use: Tea (fresh or dried, 5–7 min steep). Inhale fresh leaves before speaking or writing. Essential oil diffused at desk.
herbs.caution: Avoid with young infants. May relax esophageal sphincter — caution with GERD.

herbs.name: Lemon Verbena
herbs.why: Venus in Gemini 24° — beauty through language. Lemon Verbena is the herb of joy in the nervous system. The body responding to the sound of its own voice with pleasure.
herbs.use: Fresh or dried tea (strong, 10 min). Combine with lavender. Rub fresh leaves on wrists.
herbs.caution: Avoid in large amounts during pregnancy.
herbs.source: Matthew Wood; Traditional European and South American herbalism

tarot.meaning: The card of Gemini. Not romance — choice. The moment of discernment between two paths, two voices, two selves. This is Gemini Season's core teaching.
The Magician holds all four tools and knows how to use them. As Mercury moves from body-wisdom into speech, the tools become words. Speak with precision.
The farmer looking at what grew — not in despair, but in honest evaluation. Before you speak what you've learned, you have to honestly see it.

politicalMirror.headline: AI and language model governance becomes primary legislative battleground globally
politicalMirror.skyReading: Uranus in Gemini — the revolution in language, media, and how information is received is at its first degree. Every regulatory discussion about AI is a discussion about who controls the word.
politicalMirror.historicalParallel: Uranus last in Gemini: 1942–1949 — the invention of modern telecommunications, the first computers, the birth of mass broadcast media. We are at the beginning of the next revolution of that magnitude.

politicalMirror.headline: Russia-Ukraine ceasefire enters third week; peace terms remain unresolved
politicalMirror.skyReading: Mercury in Taurus III / Saturn-Neptune in Aries — slow, body-weight negotiations of a peace neither side can fully believe. Saturn says: structure it or it dissolves. Neptune says: every word contains what is unsaid.
politicalMirror.historicalParallel: Armistice negotiations after World War I: words that ended fighting but structured the next war. The treaty is only as good as the consciousness of those who write it.

politicalMirror.headline: Climate displacement accelerates: unprecedented migration from South Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa
politicalMirror.skyReading: Jupiter in Cancer (home, migration, the ancestral land) — the deep ocean of displacement is connected to where we are meant to be going together. The Great Migration is a cosmological event.
politicalMirror.historicalParallel: The Partition of India, 1947 (last Jupiter in Cancer cycle) — the largest forced migration in human history. This cycle calls us to do it differently.
politicalMirror.source: Pattern analysis · Jupiter in Cancer cycle

sacredCalendar.name: Malcolm X's Birthday
sacredCalendar.note: El-Hajj Malik El-Shabazz. A man who remade his own name, his own language, his own cosmology in real time. The Gemini threshold holds his memory.

sacredCalendar.name: Gemini Season Begins
sacredCalendar.note: Sun enters Gemini at approximately 3:37 AM EDT. The season of language, duality, and perception. What you name this season is what you make real.

sacredCalendar.name: Beltane Season Closes
sacredCalendar.note: The creative fertility impulse now channels into form — the work of summer. The fire of Beltane becomes the speech of Gemini.

sacredCalendar.name: First Quarter Moon
sacredCalendar.note: The moon at ninety degrees from the sun. Tension becomes productive. Build now.

sacredCalendar.name: Full Flower Moon
sacredCalendar.note: Sagittarius Full Moon. The truth revealed at peak bloom. What have you been growing toward all spring?
